The '''Derilyn system''' was a nine-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] located in [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] that was home to the planet of [[Derilyn]]. The primary was the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Deril]].<ref name="PotG3" />

A [[Ambush in the Derilyn system|space battle]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took place in the system during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="BoP">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter: Balance of Power Campaigns]]''</ref>
